title: What Is Symbolism?
skills: define symbolism and identify symbolic elements in texts
distinguish literal meaning from symbolic meaning
analyze how symbols contribute to theme and interpretation
support symbolic interpretations with relevant textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces symbolism as a literary technique in which objects, images, characters, or events carry meaning beyond their literal function. Supports close reading, thematic analysis, figurative interpretation, and evidence-based literary analysis across high school English courses.
